entities.name: Cylia
entities.description: A female elven shaman of Alara who blinded by Progenitus, poisoned it and saved the plane.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: Five-headed hydra avatar and worldsoul of Alara.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: Plane saved by Cylia but already separated into Shards.

entities.name: Anima
entities.description: Title of the seer leaders of the Naya elves.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: Shard whose elves descend from Cylia.

events.summary: Young Cylia begs Progenitus not to destroy the plane; it blinds her.
events.quote: Displeased with her, the worldsoul blinded the young elf.

events.summary: Cylia flings her poisoned dagger into the being's heart, revealing Progenitus's true form and saving all life.
events.quote: flung her weapon into the being's heart

events.summary: Cylia gains a connection with Progenitus and the ability to sense magic, passed on to Naya's elf leaders.
events.quote: Cylia gained a connection with Progenitus and the ability to sense magic.

relations.quote: flung her weapon into the being's heart
the most recent of whom was Mayael
